name: get_shift_record
description: get_shift_record: Retrieve the details of a specific shift for an employee, including the unit code, date, start/end times, and current status.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

shift_id.description: The shift identifier. Format: SHF-YYYYMMDD-HHMM (SHF, dash, 8-digit date, dash, 4-digit 24-hour start time). Construct it from the shift date and start time the caller provides — e.g. a shift on July 2, 2026 starting at 7:00 PM becomes SHF-20260702-1900. Read the constructed ID back to the caller to confirm before using it. Example: SHF-20260501-0700
